fields.instruction_en: Enter your full name exactly as it appears on your Aadhaar card. No initials.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna poora naam Aadhaar card ke anusar bilkul waise hi likhein. Koi sankshep nahi.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your father's name (or husband's name if married female).
fields.instruction_hi: Apne pita ka naam darj karein (vivahit mahila hain to pati ka naam).

fields.instruction_en: Select your gender from the dropdown.
Select your state from the dropdown list.
Enter the name of your district.
fields.instruction_hi: Apne zile ka naam darj karein.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number without spaces or dashes.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna 12 ank ka Aadhaar number bina kisi jagah ya dash ke darj karein.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your bank account number. Money will be transferred here.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna bank khata number darj karein. Rashi isi khate mein aaegi.

fields.instruction_en: Enter the IFSC code of your bank branch. It is printed on your passbook.
fields.instruction_hi: Apni bank shaakha ka IFSC code darj karein. Yeh aapki passbook par likha hota hai.
